# Database Schema Initialization for Phase-1

This feature initializes the phase-1 schema for the knowledge compiler database by creating all tables defined in the canonical schema metadata. It ensures the necessary PostgreSQL extensions and indexes are present, providing deterministic compiler tables for downstream usage.
